questions.concept: DES designed by IBM
questions.question: The Data Encryption Standard (DES) was designed by:
questions.explanation: DES, a conventional symmetric encryption standard, was designed by IBM.

questions.concept: Counting unpaired tags
questions.question:
How many of these HTML tags are unpaired (have no closing tag): ,

, , , ,
  • , ?
questions.explanation:
, , and are unpaired tags;

, and
  • are paired, giving 4.

questions.concept: Other names of NOT gate
questions.question: The NOT gate is known by several other names. Which of the following is NOT one of them?
questions.explanation: The NOT gate is also called complement, negation or inverter. A buffer passes its input unchanged.

questions.concept: Match the Sum target age group
questions.question: The 'Match the Sum' educational game is designed to improve the summing skills of children of which age group?
questions.explanation: The edutainment game targets children aged 5-7 years.

questions.concept: Finite automata example of phone number patterns
questions.question: Recognizing simple patterns such as phone numbers is given as an example of the capability of which machine?
questions.explanation: Finite automata can only recognize regular languages, such as simple patterns like phone numbers.

questions.concept: Second step of CPU cycle is decode
questions.question: In the CPU (machine) cycle, which step comes immediately after fetching an instruction?
questions.explanation: The CPU cycle is Fetch, Decode, Execute; decode comes second.

questions.concept: Bluetooth simultaneous communicating devices
questions.question: A Bluetooth network can include up to 255 devices. How many of them can communicate at the same time?
questions.explanation: Only 8 devices (one master plus 7 active slaves) can communicate at once, though up to 255 can be in the network.

questions.concept: Raster format identification
questions.question: Which of the following is a raster (bitmap) image format?
questions.explanation: BMP is a raster format made of pixels; SVG, EPS and WMF are vector formats.

questions.concept: PROM no editing possible
questions.question: Which type of ROM can be programmed once but allows no editing afterwards?
questions.explanation: PROM (Programmable ROM) allows no editing once written; EPROM and EEPROM can be erased and rewritten.

questions.concept: Purpose of flag in selection sort algorithm
questions.question: In the selection sort algorithm, a variable flag is set to 1 inside the inner loop. What is its purpose?

options.A: To mark the position of the largest element
options.B: To stop the algorithm when the list is already sorted
options.C: To count the number of passes completed
options.D: To perform the swap only when a smaller element than numList[i] was found

questions.explanation: flag becomes 1 only when numList[j] < numList[min], so the swap of numList[i] and numList[min] happens only when a smaller element was found.

questions.concept: Windows 3.1 does not support networking
questions.question: Which Windows version does not support networking?
questions.explanation: Windows 3.1 does not support networking. Windows NT and its successors were designed with networking support.

questions.concept: Binary data types in Python
questions.question: Which group lists Python's binary data types?
questions.explanation: bytes, bytearray and memoryview are the binary data types. int, float and complex are numeric types, and list, tuple and range are sequences.

questions.concept: Spooling is a printer technique, not an attack
questions.question: Which of the following terms refers to a legitimate technique used with printers rather than a cyber attack?
questions.explanation: Spooling (Simultaneous Peripheral Operations Online) is used in printers, while spoofing, sniffing and skimming are attacks.

questions.concept: Developer of Python
questions.question: Who developed the Python programming language?
questions.explanation: Python was developed by Guido van Rossum. Ritchie created C, Gosling Java and Stroustrup C++.

questions.concept: Number of constructor types in C++
questions.question: As per the syllabus, how many types of constructors are there in C++?
questions.explanation: C++ constructors are classified into three types: default, parameterized and copy constructors.

questions.concept: Many-to-many relationship scenario
questions.question: A student can enrol in several courses, and each course can have several students. What is the cardinality of the ENROLS relationship between STUDENT and COURSE?
questions.explanation: Since many students relate to one course and many courses relate to one student, the relationship is M:N.

questions.concept: Windows Explorer as file and folder manager
questions.question: In Windows, which component is used to manage files and folders?
questions.explanation: Windows Explorer is the files and folder manager in Windows.

questions.concept: Values returned by a mixed sequence of deque deletions
questions.question: A deque uses a Python list where insertFront is insert(0, x), insertRear is append(x), deletionFront is pop(0) and deletionRear is pop(). Starting empty: insertRear(4), insertFront(7), insertRear(9), deletionFront(), deletionRear(), insertFront(1), deletionRear(). Which values are returned by the three deletions, in order?
questions.explanation: The list becomes [7, 4, 9]; deletionFront returns 7 and deletionRear returns 9, leaving [4]; insertFront(1) gives [1, 4] and deletionRear returns 4.

questions.concept: Assigning to a tuple element raises TypeError
questions.question:
What happens when the following code runs?
t = (1, 2, 3)
t[0] = 5
questions.explanation: A tuple is immutable, so assigning to one of its elements raises TypeError.

questions.concept: Nesting of AI, ML and deep learning
questions.question: Which statement correctly describes the relationship among AI, Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL)?

options.A: ML is a subset of DL, and DL is a subset of AI
options.B: AI is a subset of ML, and ML is a subset of DL
options.C: DL is a subset of ML, and ML is a subset of AI
options.D: AI, ML and DL are independent, non-overlapping fields

questions.explanation: AI enables machines to mimic human behaviour; ML is a subset of AI using statistical methods; DL is a subset of ML making multi-layer neural networks feasible.

questions.concept: Correct grammar type, language class and machine triple
questions.question: Which triple of grammar type, language class and accepting machine is correctly matched?
questions.explanation: Type 0 is RE (TM), Type 1 context-sensitive (LBA), Type 2 context-free (PDA) and Type 3 regular (FA).

questions.concept: Ones complement of 5
questions.explanation: ~ flips every bit of the int. For two's complement integers ~x equals -(x + 1), so ~5 = -6.

questions.concept: Database instance as snapshot of database state
questions.question: In a DBMS, what is the term for the state or snapshot of the database at a particular moment after data has been loaded into it?
questions.explanation: A database instance is the state or snapshot of the database after data is loaded; the schema is the design, metadata is data about data.

questions.concept: Five components of data communication
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT one of the five components of data communication?
questions.explanation: The five components are sender, receiver, message, communication medium and protocol.

questions.concept: Publish-subscribe model for low power devices
questions.question: Which IoT communication model is considered most efficient for devices that need low power consumption?
questions.explanation: In publish/subscribe (used by MQTT), devices send only when they have data and do not keep polling, saving power.
